content.text:
I added a nesting limit of 64 parenthesis levels to the parser in `core/license_expr.py`. A deeper expression now gets `Needs review` with the reason "cannot parse: expression is nested too deeply (more than 64 levels)", instead of a `RecursionError`. I couldn't run code here, so this is untested.

`core/decide.py` catches the new error and leaves the huge expression out of the reason text. Expressions nested up to 64 levels, `OR`/`AND` handling and ordinary parse errors are unchanged.
